name: Eyas
source:
Fallen from the nest, the tiny hawk trembles, lost and longing for a mother who won’t answer.

A worn fox stumbles upon him, and in his fragile life, she finds meaning.

[From [url=https://bluebirdplays.itch.io/eyas]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
小鹰从巢里掉下来，浑身发抖，迷失了方向，渴望得到一个不会回答的母亲。

一只疲惫的狐狸偶然发现了他，在他脆弱的生活中，她找到了意义。

[来自[url=https://bluebirdplays.itch.io/eyas]Itch.io[/url]]
